battle_pause.doc: The battle pause (M2-MNU-04; docs/kb/tech/ui.md section Battle pause). 'action' is added to the InputMap at runtime when missing (FieldInput.add_actions: keys by OS.find_keycode_from_string name, joy_buttons by JoyButton value, 6 = Start). Pressing it on a player's or an enemy's turn pauses the whole tree (the engine, BattleChoreo, the camera, tweens) under the pause page; pressing it again or Resume lifts it. 'blocked_states' are BattleController states where it does nothing (no fight on, or the result panel is up). Rects are x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference, multiples of 3; the panel sits over the battle HUD (canvas layer 1) and under the Settings hub (66). 'dim_alpha' darkens the battle under the page (the theme's panel_low swatch at that alpha), so a paused fight reads as paused.
